personality_one_liner: A sleek, command-center experience optimized for fast scanning, precise bookings, and rugged masculine grooming, anchored by Kupang-inspired warm sandalwood accents.

spacing.rule: Dense and tactical. Use dividers and tonal separation over heavy shadows. Maintain strict grid alignment.

do's: Use solid surfaceSecondary and surfaceTertiary with clear borders for layering.
dont's: No blur or glassmorphism. This app requires performance-first, sweat-proof, operational clarity.

screens.name: Customer - Home (GPS Discovery)
screens.purpose: Discover nearest barbershops via Haversine sorting with a prominent CTA for AI Hairstyle Recommendation.

states.loading: Dark skeleton cards with subtle pulse, skeleton map placeholder.
states.empty: Phosphor MapPin icon + 'No barbershops found nearby in Kupang' + 'Refresh Location' brand CTA.

screens.layout: Sticky top search/filter row. AI Face Scan CTA floats above the list as a brandTertiary tinted banner with a face-scan illustration. Main content is a vertical list of barbershop cards (distance prominently displayed in Barlow Condensed). Thumb zone contains the bottom tabs.

screens.name: Customer - AI Face Scan & Recommendation
screens.purpose: Analyze face shape via camera/upload and present instant, explainable hairstyle recommendations.

states.loading: Bounding box pulsing with 'Analyzing facial landmarks...' text. <1s delay.
states.empty: Face not detected prompt. Single sentence warning (e.g., 'Move to even lighting').

screens.layout: Minimalist capture screen with real-time bounding box and tilt guards. Instant results dashboard: visually distinct 'Detected Shape: Oval' (with explanation 'Why?'), followed by horizontal scroll of recommended hairstyles using large image cards and 'Book This Style' CTA.

screens.name: Customer - 4-Step Booking & QRIS Payment
screens.purpose: Streamlined booking flow culminating in a time-sensitive QRIS payment.

states.loading: Loading slots or generating QR code...
states.empty: No slots available for selected date.

screens.layout: Progress indicator at the top. Split panels for shop/service/barber selection. Time slots displayed in dense, tactical grid (pill controls). Payment screen features a massive, oversized countdown timer (Bebas/Barlow Condensed) dominating the top half, with the QRIS code cleanly contained in a surfaceInverse container for scanability.

screens.name: Owner - Dashboard & Realtime Orders
screens.purpose: Command center for barbershop owners to view stats, manage incoming orders, and track employee evaluation.

states.empty: Zero orders today. 'Wait for incoming bookings'.

screens.layout: Operational dashboard. Oversized metrics for 'Today's Orders' and 'Revenue' in Barlow Condensed. Persistent status visibility. Real-time incoming orders arrive as high-contrast notification toasts at the top. Sectioned layout for managing Barber/Service/Schedule CRUD.

screens.name: Admin - Verification & Monitoring
screens.purpose: Data-dense operational table for verifying KTP/NIB/NPWP and suspending non-compliant shops.
screens.layout: Desktop-like density optimized for mobile. Stacked modules, sticky filter rows, and split panels. Status badges (Pending, Verified, Suspended) use strict status colors. Quick-action swipe rows for mass-cancel or approve.

hero_barbershop.alt: premium black and silver barber chair in industrial interior

ai_face_scan.alt: Conceptual portrait with red laser scanning for facial recognition

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the Dark-First Utility DARK guidelines. Do not use blur or glassmorphism; this is a rugged, fast-scanning operational app.
Implement the UI using a deep obsidian background (#121212) with high-contrast Terracotta/Amber (#FF5722) accents. Do NOT use any blue, purple, or indigo.
Ensure the QRIS payment screen utilizes Barlow Condensed for a massive, aggressive countdown timer, mimicking sports/tactical operational UI.
For the AI Face Scan UI, implement a clear bounding box with a tilt/rotation guard UI. Use short, single-sentence guidance text like 'Move to even lighting'.
Owner and Admin dashboards must be dense, utilizing 'sm' radius and 'sm'/'md' spacing to maximize data visibility without scrolling.
Ensure all lists of real entities (Barbershops, Karyawan) prefer real photo avatars or logos; fallback to initials inside a brandTertiary tinted circle.
Text overlaid on images must use a mandatory vertical linear gradient scrim (0% to >70% surfaceInverse) to guarantee contrast.
